description: POWER and SQRT over a nullable operand are nullable -- the #163 gap: the existing math_power_sqrt fixture only used a NOT NULL operand, so it couldn't tell a sound implementation from an unsound one

columns.name: squared
columns.note: value is nullable, so POWER(value, 2) is nullable

columns.name: root
columns.note: value is nullable, so SQRT(value) is nullable

name: math_power_sqrt_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name PowerSqrtNullable
-- @returns :many
SELECT POWER(value, 2) AS squared, SQRT(value) AS root FROM measurements
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE measurements (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, value DOUBLE PRECISION);
